CFML Language Reference: Functions

QuerySetCell

Stores a value in the given column of the given row of a query.

Category

Query functions

Syntax

QuerySetCell(query, column_name, value [, row_number ])

Parameters

query
A query, from QueryNew or CFQUERY.
column_name
Name of an existing column. An unknown column throws an Expression exception.
value
The value to store.
row_number
The row to change, from 1 to query.RecordCount. The default is the last row.

Returns

TRUE (prints as YES).

Usage

The row must already exist; use QueryAddRow first. You can also change cells of a CFQUERY result, for example to add a calculated value before output. Only the query in memory changes.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFQUERY NAME="GetStaff" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
SELECT TOP 4 FirstName, LastName, Salary
FROM Employees
ORDER BY LastName
</CFQUERY>
<!--- Give everybody a Y2K bonus (in memory only!) --->
<CFLOOP QUERY="GetStaff">
  <CFSET Temp = QuerySetCell(GetStaff, "Salary", Salary + 2000, CurrentRow)>
</CFLOOP>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Name</TH><TH>Salary with bonus</TH></TR>
<CFOUTPUT QUERY="GetStaff">
<TR><TD>#FirstName# #LastName#</TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#DollarFormat(Salary)#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</TABLE>

See also

QueryAddRow, QueryNew, QueryAddColumn
